title: Risk of Rain 2
provenance: Reported by PrisedRabbit (highball-db#368, 2026-10-07), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.12, engine x64-crossover26.3-r21, DXMT as the game's own mode in an environment set to D3DMetal with sync none, rated 5 of 5 after 46 minutes. Second report by murilopereirame (highball-db#414, 2026-10-08), Apple M3, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-crossover26.3-r19, the environment in D3DMetal mode with sync none and AVX advertised (the report names DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 5 hours: frame times a bit uneven, the health bar missing until a mod fixed it. Not verified by the maintainer. jackverstraate (highball-db#621, 2026-10-22), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes, with the health bars of the character and enemies not drawn properly and the game not quitting fully on the way back to the desktop.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on the Wine 11 engine over 46 minutes, and playable over 5 hours on an M3 with frame times a bit uneven and the health bar missing until the player added the MetalSafeBars mod. No measurement here yet. A third report, on an M5 Pro with the default engine r28, sees the health bars of the character and enemies drawn wrong too, and the game not quitting fully when going back to the desktop.

knownIssues.symptom: The health bar is missing (also reported as the character's and enemies' health bars not rendering properly on an M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, DXMT, engine r28)
knownIssues.cause: not measured here. The game's health bars don't draw through the Metal translation layers, CrossOver players see it too.
knownIssues.fix: The MetalSafeBars mod (a BepInEx plugin, github.com/Krabik6/MetalSafeBars) draws the health and shield bars as an overlay and brought them back for one player. r2modmac (github.com/Zard-Studios/r2modmac), a Mac mod manager for Thunderstore, helps install BepInEx and the mod.

knownIssues.symptom: The game does not quit fully when going back to the desktop (reported on an M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, DXMT, engine r28)
